Routing notes (updated through REQ-2409):
- Use request size + type + region; sender role, subject wording ("second attempt", "client asking twice") are not reliable routing cues.

Decision rule:
1. Small requests -> standard queue A.
2. Large requests -> priority desk B.
3. Exception: large shipment from south region -> regional office C.

Evidence:
- Large renewal, south: B accepted (REQ-2400).
- Large shipment, south: C accepted (REQ-2401, REQ-2406).
- C rejected for: small renewal north (REQ-2402, REQ-2403), large/small claim east (REQ-2404, REQ-2405), large renewal south (REQ-2407), small claim north (REQ-2408), large shipment east (REQ-2409).
- Therefore do not route to C unless it is a large shipment from the south region.
- If C is invalid or unavailable: small -> A; large -> B. This fits renewal south large (B) and all C-rejected large cases implying B.
- C is not a general "regional office" fallback.

Open checks:
- Small south shipment: untested; default A unless C specifically indicated.
- Large renewal from other regions: untested; default B.
- Claims: no priority exception seen; small -> A, large -> B.

Routing notes (updated through REQ-2419)
Use size + type + region. Sender role and subject wording remain unreliable.

Rules:
- Claims: all sizes/regions -> A. Small east A accepted (2410/2417); large north B rejected (2412); C rejected for claim tests.
- Renewals: large -> B (2400, 2413, 2415). Small north -> A. Small south -> B (A rejected 2418; C not valid for renewals).
- Shipments: south -> C (large accepted 2401/2406/2416; small south A rejected 2419, so C expected). Non-south: large -> B (C rejected east 2409); small -> A default.
- Invoices: large north -> B accepted (2411). Large east -> not B (2414); likely A. Small/other regions untested; default A unless B indicated.

Invalid/unavailable:
- C only for south shipments. Do not use C for claims, renewals, invoices, or non-south shipments.
- If B rejected: claims and large east invoices -> A.
- If A rejected: small south renewal -> B; small south shipment -> C.

Open checks:
- Confirm small south shipment C.
- Confirm large east invoice A.
- Test small non-south shipment/invoice, south invoice, small invoice, large shipment north/west, small renewal east.

Routing notes (updated through REQ-2429)
Use size + type + region. Sender/subject wording unreliable.

Rules:
- Claims: small -> A (2410/2417, 2428). Large north: A rejected (2425), B rejected (2412); C now likely remaining option—confirm. Do not default all claims to A.
- Renewals: large -> B (2400,2413,2415,2422 incl south). Small north -> A. Small south -> B.
- Shipments: south -> C (large accepted; small south A rejected). Non-south large: B rejected north (2424), C rejected east; try A. Small non-south -> A.
- Invoices: large north -> B (2411). Large east -> not B; likely A. Small east -> A (2423,2427). Small/other -> A default.
- Transfers: likely A. Small north A accepted (2420); large north B rejected (2429); large south C rejected (2426). Confirm large transfer A.
- Refunds: small east A accepted (2421); likely A; more tests needed.

Invalid/unavailable:
- C: accepted for south shipments; rejected for renewals, invoices, transfers, non-south shipments. Claim-C status unclear; large north C pending.
- B invalid for large north shipment, large north transfer, large north claim.
- A invalid for large north claim, small south renewal/shipment.

Fallbacks:
- If A rejected: small south renewal -> B; small south shipment -> C.
- If B rejected: non-claim/large shipment/transfer -> A; large north claim -> C pending.

Open checks:
- Confirm large transfer A; large east invoice A; small south shipment C; large north claim C.
- Test large non-south shipment A, south invoice, small invoice/shipment other regions, refunds, small renewal east.

Routing notes (updated REQ-2439)
Use size+type+region. Sender/subject wording unreliable.

Rules by type:
Claims: small -> A (incl east). Large north: A/B rejected; C likely remaining—confirm. Not all claims A.
Renewals: large -> B (incl south). Small north -> A. Small south -> B.
Shipments: south -> C (large accepted; small south A rejected). Large non-south: B rejected north, C rejected east; try A. Small non-south -> A, except small north A rejected (2436); unknown.
Invoices: large north -> B. Large east -> not B, likely A. Large south -> A. Small east -> A. Small north -> A rejected; unknown. Other small -> A default pending tests.
Transfers: A confirmed: small south (2433), large north (2432). Likely A.
Refunds: A likely/accepted: large east (2437), small east (2421), small south (2438).
Audits: new; small south A rejected (2439); unknown.

Invalid/unavailable:
C: accepted south shipments; rejected renewals, invoices, transfers, non-south shipments. Claim-C unclear; large north claim C pending.
B: invalid large north shipment/claim/transfer.
A: invalid large north claim; small south renewal/shipment; small north invoice/shipment; small south audit (2439).

Fallbacks:
If A rejected: small south renewal -> B; small south shipment -> C. For new unknowns (small north invoice/shipment, small south audit), C/B untested.
If B rejected: non-claim/large shipment/transfer -> A; large north claim -> C pending.

Open checks:
Confirm large north claim C; large east invoice A; test small north invoice/shipment, small south audit, small renewal east, south invoice, large non-south shipment A.

Routing notes (updated REQ-2449)
Use size+type+region. Sender/subject wording unreliable.

Rules by type:
Claims: small east -> A (2440,2446). Large north: A/B rejected; C likely—confirm. Small south A rejected (2443); B/C unknown. Not all claims A.
Renewals: large -> B (incl south, north, east; 2444). Small north -> A. Small south -> B. Small east unknown.
Shipments: south -> C (large accepted; small south A rejected). Large non-south: B rejected north, C rejected east; try A. Small non-south -> A, except small north A rejected (2436); unknown.
Invoices: large north -> B. Large east -> A confirmed (2442,2447). Large south -> A (2449). Small east/south -> A (2448). Small north A rejected; unknown. Other small -> A default.
Transfers: A confirmed small south (2433), large north (2432). Likely A.
Refunds: A likely/accepted large east (2437), small east (2421), small south (2438).
Audits: small south A rejected (2439); large south B rejected (2445). A/C unknown.

Invalid/unavailable:
C: accepted south shipments; rejected renewals, invoices, transfers, non-south shipments. Claim-C unclear; large north claim C pending.
B: invalid large north shipment/claim/transfer; large south audit B rejected.
A: invalid large north claim; small south claim/renewal/shipment/audit; small north invoice/shipment.

Fallbacks:
If A rejected: small south renewal -> B; small south shipment -> C; small south claim -> B/C untested.
If B rejected: non-claim/large shipment/transfer -> A; large north claim -> C pending; large south audit -> A/C untested.

Open checks:
Confirm large north claim C. Test small north invoice/shipment, small south audit, small renewal east, small claim south fallback, large south audit.

Routing notes updated REQ-2459
Use size+type+region. Sender/subject unreliable.

Rules:
Claims: small east -> A. Large east -> A (2451). Large north A/B rejected; C likely pending. Small south A rejected; B/C unknown. Not all claims A.
Renewals: large -> B (all regions; 2444,2458). Small north -> A. Small south -> B. Small east unknown.
Shipments: south -> C (large accepted; small south A rejected). Large non-south: A likely (B rejected north, C rejected east). Small non-south: not A if north/east (2436,2456); B rejected small north (2454). Other small C unknown.
Invoices: large north -> B. Large east/south -> A (2442,2447,2449,2457). Small east/south -> A (2448). Small north A rejected; unknown. Other small -> A default.
Transfers: A likely (2433,2432).
Refunds: A likely/accepted large east, small east, small south.
Audits: small south A rejected (2439). Large south A/B rejected (2445,2459); C likely. Large east/north A rejected (2450,2453). Small unknown.
Onboarding: small south A rejected (2452); large east A rejected (2455). Desk unknown.

Invalid/unavailable:
C: accepted south shipments; rejected renewals, invoices, transfers, non-south shipments. Claim-C unclear; large north claim pending.
B: invalid large north shipment/claim/transfer; large south audit B rejected; small north shipment B rejected.
A: invalid large north claim; small south claim/renewal/shipment/audit; small north invoice/shipment; small east shipment; large north/east/south audit; small south/large east onboarding.

Fallbacks:
A rejected: small south renewal -> B; small south shipment -> C; small south claim -> B/C untested. Large audits -> C if available. Small north/east shipments -> C untested.
B rejected: non-claim/large shipment/transfer -> A; large north claim -> C pending; large south audit -> C likely.

Open checks:
Confirm large north claim C. Test small north invoice, small south audit, small renewal east, small claim south fallback, large south audit C, small north/east shipment C, onboarding desks.
